# OdooTeams

> Professional Odoo ERP implementation, customization, training, and development services worldwide.

OdooTeams helps businesses adopt and scale Odoo ERP with expert implementation, custom module development, training, and ongoing support. The site is bilingual (English and Arabic).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of OdooTeams services and value proposition.
- [About](/about): Company background, team, and history.
- [Services](/services): Catalog of Odoo implementation, customization, training, and support services.
- [Projects](/projects): Portfolio of completed Odoo implementations.
- [Learn Odoo](/learn-odoo): Free tutorials, guides, and learning resources for Odoo ERP.
- [FAQs](/faqs): Answers to common questions about Odoo and our services.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the OdooTeams team.
